full_prompt_en: A square Baroque-style oil painting compresses a lively group of older men into an intimate, shadowy room. At the center, a gray-bearded man in a dark cap and russet coat turns toward another man at the right. His eyebrows arch, eyes widen, and mouth opens as if speaking mid-story. A hand near his shoulder punctuates the exchange. The right-hand listener is shown mostly from behind, with a balding crown, large ear, and thick dark beard, his warm ochre clothing close to the front edge. At the left, two more men overlap in partial profile and shadow. Behind the central head, a glint of gold and additional indistinct faces deepen the crowd, while dim carved or patterned interior details remain barely visible. The composition is close enough that bodies and faces press against all four edges, leaving little empty room. Warm light falls from the upper-left, illuminating forehead wrinkles, pink cheeks, noses, hands, and the white curls of the central beard. The surrounding dark browns and black clothing absorb light, creating strong chiaroscuro without making the faces flat. Paint is blended in the lit skin but thicker and more visibly dragged through hair, fabric, and shadowed background. Ochre, russet, umber, warm flesh pink, and gray-white form the limited palette. There is no legible text or modern object. The whole image feels animated and conversational, its energy arising from turned heads, expressive eyes, and illuminated skin emerging from densely layered darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形巴洛克感油画把一群活跃交谈的年长男子挤进亲密而阴暗的室内。中央一位灰胡男子戴深帽、穿锈红外衣，转向右侧另一人。他眉毛上挑、眼睛睁大，嘴张开，仿佛正在讲故事。一只靠近肩膀的手强调对话。右侧听者主要以背影呈现，头顶渐秃，耳朵大，留浓深胡须，暖赭色衣服贴近前缘。左侧另外两名男子的部分侧脸在阴影里重叠。中央头后，一点金色闪光和更多模糊面孔加深拥挤感，暗淡的雕刻或图案室内细节几乎看不清。构图贴近到身体和脸压住四边，几乎不留空房间。暖光从左上落下，照亮额头皱纹、粉红面颊、鼻、手和中央胡须的白色卷曲。周围深棕与黑衣吸收光，形成强烈明暗对照，又不让脸变平。受光皮肤的油彩融合，头发、布料和阴暗背景里则更厚、更可见地拖开。赭黄、锈红、赭棕、暖肤粉和灰白构成有限调色。没有可读文字或现代物件。整幅图活跃而充满交谈感，动势来自转动的头、表情丰富的眼睛和从密层黑暗中浮起的受光皮肤。
style_prompt_en: Baroque oil painting compresses overlapping forms into a close, dark field and carves depth with warm chiaroscuro. Ochre, russet, umber, flesh-like pink, and gray-white emerge selectively from broad brown-black shadow. Lit planes receive blended modeling and sharp glints, while textured curls, folds, and recesses show thicker dragged strokes. Diagonal glances and curved contours create a lively exchange across the center, even where some forms are cropped by the edges. The background contains only dim patterned hints, allowing highlighted details to carry the narrative rhythm. High contrast remains warm rather than graphic, with darkness wrapping around tactile, closely observed surfaces.
style_prompt_zh: 巴洛克油画把重叠形体压进贴近的深暗画域，再以暖色明暗对照雕出纵深。赭黄、锈红、赭棕、近肤粉和灰白有选择地从宽阔棕黑阴影中浮起。受光平面接受融合塑形与锐利闪点，带肌理的卷曲、褶皱和凹处则留下更厚拖笔。斜向视线和弯曲轮廓在中央形成活跃交流，即使部分形体被边缘截断也如此。背景只有暗淡图案提示，让亮细节承载叙事节奏。高对比仍温暖而非图形化，黑暗裹住有触感、贴近观察的表面。
theme_en: A lively close conversation among older bearded men in a crowded room
theme_zh: 拥挤室内几位留胡须的年长男子正在热烈近谈
name: Jacob Jordaens
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
